claims.text: ASP.NET Core's rate limiting middleware (AddRateLimiter + UseRateLimiter) applies a named policy to the endpoints marked [EnableRateLimiting("name")]; a request asks the endpoint's policy for a permit before the endpoint runs.
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs: Rate limiting middleware in ASP.NET Core (EnableRateLimiting, AddPolicy)

claims.text: Fixed window limiter: PermitLimit requests are allowed per Window; each request takes a permit, and when the window ends the count resets so PermitLimit requests are allowed again.
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs: Rate limiting middleware, 'Fixed window limiter'; System.Threading.RateLimiting FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions

claims.text: FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions.QueueLimit defaults to 0, so with no QueueLimit set a request beyond the permits is rejected at once instead of waiting for the next window.
claims.source_hint: API reference: System.Threading.RateLimiting.FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions.QueueLimit

claims.text: RateLimiterOptions.RejectionStatusCode defaults to 503 (Service Unavailable).
claims.source_hint: API reference: Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting.RateLimiterOptions.RejectionStatusCode; Rate limiting middleware docs

claims.text: On rejection the middleware sets the response status to RejectionStatusCode, then invokes OnRejected, which may change the status and headers; the next middleware and the endpoint are not called (short-circuit).
claims.source_hint: ASP.NET Core docs: Rate limiting middleware, RateLimiterOptions.OnRejected; AspNetCore RateLimitingMiddleware

claims.text: A failed lease from FixedWindowRateLimiter carries MetadataName.RetryAfter (a TimeSpan); context.Lease.TryGetMetadata(MetadataName.RetryAfter, out var retryAfter) reads it in OnRejected.
claims.source_hint: API reference: RateLimitLease.TryGetMetadata, MetadataName.RetryAfter; Rate limiting middleware docs OnRejected sample

claims.text: RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(key, factory) gives one fixed-window limiter per distinct key; RateLimitPartition.GetNoLimiter(key) never limits; AddPolicy(name, Func<HttpContext, RateLimitPartition<TKey>>) registers such a policy.
claims.source_hint: API reference: System.Threading.RateLimiting.RateLimitPartition; RateLimiterOptionsExtensions/AddPolicy; Rate limiting docs 'partitioned' samples
